original_test_intent: Place the SDR repository into its supported update mode for one approved maintenance transaction, prove the intended mode behavior, then guarantee exit and restored monitoring.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review identifies standard Storage 0x0a/0x2a only as a target-approved candidate within a complete enter-operation-exit transaction.
manual_activity: Owner identifies the single repository operation that requires update mode, approves its monitoring impact and maximum dwell, and owns the independent exit/recovery path.
safety_requirements: Never enter mode as an isolated probe
Arm a watchdog and guaranteed exit path
Do not add/delete records beyond approved scope
agent_execution_scope: Present exact transaction and dwell for confirmation
Perform only the separately approved bounded operation
Exit through approved paired path even on failure
Verify repository accessibility and sensor monitoring
engineer_actions: Approve the maintenance operation, expected mode effect and time limit

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek safely withholds execution but does not distinguish an unresolved source from a packageable stateful standard transition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after fresh approval, use a protected transaction whose entry is the target-approved equivalent of `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x2a`, with a pre-armed paired exit and post-state verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master's TBD body, attended time 10 and machine time 5 remain unchanged; no update payload or dwell is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat entry, the exact repository update, exit and monitoring recovery as one bounded auditable transaction with watchdog and independent recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds Review-layer transactional safety and acceptance while preserving Master TBD.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A repository-info read cannot validate update-mode entry; an exit success alone also cannot establish that entry produced the intended guarded state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stranded update mode or incomplete transaction can make SDR content unavailable or inconsistent and degrade platform monitoring.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API may replace raw entry only if it exposes equivalent mode state, transactional ownership, bounded duration, guaranteed exit and repository/monitoring evidence. Tool success without state proof is insufficient.
expected_evidence: Fresh approval and exact transaction scope
Entry payload/completion and observed update-mode behavior
Post-exit repository integrity and monitoring health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items name a stateful maintenance command, while Procedure and Criteria are TBD and generic log clearing would remove evidence. No operation, exit or acceptance oracle is defined in Master, so Review must preserve the gap and add conditional transaction controls.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The state transition is identifiable and can be safely reviewed. Missing target semantics, operation, approval and exit package postpone execution but do not make the review permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Prevents an unattended or orphaned repository update mode by binding entry to one authorized operation, a hard dwell limit, paired exit and post-recovery monitoring checks.
independent_technical_reasoning: The risk is not merely the entry command; it is the lifetime of a global repository maintenance state. A valid test must observe ownership and repository behavior while guaranteeing an exit under error paths. Those controls require a project package and human confirmation, so full unattended automation is inappropriate.
